ns1:channel.ns1:title: npj Urban Sustainability
ns1:channel.ns1:description:
Open for Submissions

Publishing high-quality research on sustainable urbanization and how cities and their regions are reshaping to meet major economic, social and environmental challenges.

npj Urban Sustainability is a fully open-access journal that aims to highlight critical studies, case studies and impact studies, including policy solutions for existing cities and regions, and projects for new urban developments.

npj Urban Sustainability covers topics including, but not limited to, scaling, distribution and density changes of urbanizing regions; urban metabolism and informatics; ecology, architecture and city planning for sustainable environments in new and existing cities; integration of innovative technology and solutions for urban data; economic, social and environmental challenges such as inequality, climate change, food, health, energy and accountability.

In addition to original research, the journal welcomes critical Reviews, and thought-provoking Perspectives and Comment articles.
